data.one_liner: Flutter plugin providing Text-To-Speech (TTS) service for Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter apps to convert text into spoken audio. It supports speaking, stopping, pausing, resuming, and configuring volume, rate, pitch, language, and voices across multiple platforms.
use_when: You need to synthesize text into speech across Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
You want to configure speech rate, pitch, volume, and select specific languages or voices.
avoid_when: You need Linux or Windows implementations, which are not currently supported.
You need utterance status listeners, which are currently pending/todo.
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
Provides controls for volume, rate, pitch, language, and voice selection.
weaknesses: Utterance status listener is listed as a TODO.
data.setup_notes: Android minimum SDK version 21, and applications targeting SDK 30 need to declare TextToSpeech.Engine.INTENT_ACTION_TTS_SERVICE in the queries elements of Android Manifest. iOS minimum version 7.0, macOS minimum version 10.14.
